response: authority: compatibility prose, never authority grant

fields.sessionKey: String(input??empty); phase8 itself has no cap
fields.clientId: string<=100 or null; folder may establish effective client

scope.policy: Phase8 checks requested/folder client mismatch then uses folder client; research context checks client current member/tenant/not archived/memory wall. Proposed trusted effective scope must not be inferred from model echo.

selectors.monitorId: optional truthy selector; exact tenant+owner lookup

result.matchDefinition: null or id/version/query/fields/interpretation from owned monitor
result.items: up to limit raw current news observations plus saved:boolean, tracking_version:integer|null
result.nextOffset: offset+limit if fetch has extra row, else null
result.coverage: all configured coverage rows extended with intake and retained aggregates

news.clock: since computed from own Date.now. Propose trusted observationWindowStart/asOf fact; generatedAt is later and cannot prove exact equality.
news.coverage: Configured availability, per-endpoint intake status, and retained article observations remain distinct. Newer failure remains authoritative despite older successes/articles. Intake complete=false alone is not failure. Empty result never proves absence.

sourceView.selector: view=source; kind news/budget/personnel/research and id string1..200; kind selects exact stored revision lookup

branches.news: raw observation plus SourceRow aliases; body_complete governs complete
branches.budget: raw document plus joined section text and stage authority
branches.personnel: raw observation plus payload.sourceText-or-empty; complete:true is this projection, not corpus completeness
branches.research: ResearchVersion-derived exact text/sections, empty sourceUrl fallback; no raw news/personnel fields

sourceView.limits: Unsupported kinds and missing row throw. Outer feature lane is budget only for kind budget, otherwise news. Preserve rather than invent broader research authorization.

personnelView.selectors: kind change|registration defaultchange; year Number(default local-calendar current year); branch empty|legislative|executive; q first200; offset truncate/nonnegative<=10000
personnelView.result: items<=100 raw latest personnel observations plus saved/tracking_version; nextOffset; year; notice. No scope field.
personnelView.clock: Current-year default is local calendar getFullYear, not UTC. Recommend trusted defaultYear rather than silently reinterpret timezone.
personnelView.truth: Registration withdrawal is not employment termination; unresolved identities stay unmerged.

monitorsView.selectors: input otherwise ignored; default empty scope
monitorsView.result: monitors array of exact tenant+owner rows whose per-config scopes remain visible; each adds full compileNewsQuery interpretation object
monitorsView.limits: No producer cap/total. NotFound/Forbidden scoped monitors filtered; no all-tenant completeness. Stored source/config/pending_window remain opaque inert JSON.
monitorsView.privateProjection: Owner/tenant/source configuration identifiers are private actor-scoped data, not public news.

floridaBudget.selectors: q first200; fiscalYear default2026-27 matches20xx-xx without consecutive-year guarantee; projectId String; integer offset0..10000

result.projects: <=100 raw project rows plus recentAmounts<=4 per project
result.documents: up to101 selected fields, not truncated to100
result.amounts: if projectId, up to501 id/observation pairs; else empty
result.events: up to101 event rows plus document title/source_url/stage/fiscal_year
result.notice: request/chamber alternatives do not establish awarded amounts

floridaBudget.opaque: Project identities/relations/evidence; document metadata; event payload; amount observation are JSONB. BudgetAmount imported type explains source meaning but DB does not force every JSON row into that DTO. Do not impose guaranteed BudgetAmount fields on arbitrary persisted observation without ingestion proof.
floridaBudget.money: BudgetAmount uses exact decimal minorUnits string|null; basis recurring/nonrecurring/total; measure money/positions/percentage; amount/blank/omitted/embedded/unpublished; stage/chamber/offer/role and qualified distinct. Do not sum stages or conflate allocation_amount/vetoed_amount.
